Vendored third-party libraries for DocForge (no npm at runtime).

pdf-lib.min.js
  Package: pdf-lib
  Version: 1.17.1
  License: MIT
  Source: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib

pdf.min.js / pdf.worker.min.js
  Package: pdfjs-dist (PDF.js)
  Version: 3.11.174
  License: Apache-2.0
  Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

jszip.min.js
  Package: jszip
  Version: 3.10.1
  License: MIT
  Source: https://github.com/Stuk/jszip

tesseract/ (Extract text OCR)
  Package: tesseract.js 5.1.1 + tesseract.js-core 5.1.0
  License: Apache-2.0 (Tesseract) / MIT (tesseract.js)
  Language data: English tessdata 4.0.0_fast (eng.traineddata.gz)
  Source: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js

Keep versions in sync when updating. Prefer UMD/IIFE builds for classic script tags.
